target_rationale: The trusted inventory describes gridded ERA5 pressure-level data on a regular latitude-longitude grid, and the frozen contract requests repeated ML training reads as a full_field_tensor with recommended Zarr v3 output. This matches the supplied regular_rectilinear_grid -> zarr v3 -> full_field_tensor evaluator target.

axes.semantic: Each sample is one UTC valid time formed from the inclusive contract date range 2024-01-01 through 2024-01-07 and selected_times 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, and 18:00 UTC, ordered deterministically by timestamp.
axes.evidence: Contract scope declares an inclusive date_range, selected_times, timestep of 6 hours, and timezone UTC; inventory option_units marks time as UTC and temporal_resolution as Hourly.

axes.semantic: Latitude coordinate of the regular rectilinear latitude-longitude grid for the declared global CDS area, using the contract cds_area_order north, west, south, east for scope interpretation.
axes.evidence: Inventory data_description states projection is Regular latitude-longitude grid and reanalysis horizontal resolution is 0.25° x 0.25°; contract geography declares area global with cds_area [90, -180, -90, 180].

axes.semantic: Longitude coordinate of the regular rectilinear latitude-longitude grid for the declared global CDS area, using the contract cds_area_order north, west, south, east for scope interpretation.
axes.evidence: Inventory data_description states projection is Regular latitude-longitude grid and horizontal_coverage is Global; contract geography declares area global with cds_area [90, -180, -90, 180].

fields.rationale: Frozen contract declares field name geopotential with selector pressure_level value 500 hPa. No tolerance, conversion, aggregation, or derived feature is declared.
Frozen contract declares field name temperature with selector pressure_level value 500 hPa. No tolerance, conversion, aggregation, or derived feature is declared.

oracle.description: Prepare an evaluator-owned regular-grid oracle from immutable local fixture replay for exactly the frozen contract scope and fields. The oracle must expose complete logical coordinates for sample UTC timestamps, latitude, longitude, and all three mapped field channels, preserving native values and missingness independently of any candidate output layout or Zarr implementation.
independence_requirements: Oracle materialization and decoding must be evaluator-owned and independent of candidate code.
Provider network access is disabled; use only immutable local fixture replay accepted as trusted source context.
Oracle identities and hashes must be recorded before candidate execution.
Oracle must cover exactly the contract date range, selected UTC times, global area, product_type reanalysis, data_format grib, download_format unarchived, and selected pressure-level fields.
